sources.quote: I moved into my place in Lake Merritt and it's been a real adjustment. The other night, the wind was rattling the window frame near the front porch and I couldn't sleep. approvedQuotes.text: I moved into my place in Lake Merritt and it's been a real adjustment. The other night, the wind was rattling the window frame near the front porch and I couldn't sleep. It got me thinking about some of the decisions I've made, wondering if they were the right ones. I've been seeing some familiar faces around the neighborhood, like Vinnie Keane at Grand Avenue Wine Bar. It's nice to have some continuity.

I've been feeling pretty settled in Rockridge. I attended a community feedback session for the Fruitvale Transit Hub Phase II and actually felt heard, which was a positive experience. It's nice to be involved in the community.
To be honest, the BART train disruption was just a minor frustration for me. I've gotten used to it around here. I rewound the belt haul on my walk home and didn't think much of it.

I read the flyer for the Oakland Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline and honestly, I wondered who was actually going to get those spots. It's great they're offering opportunities, but I've seen programs like this before where the benefits don't always reach the kids who need them most.
